PROCEDURE VALIDATE_CONTRACT_ID IS
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
 temp_buffer VARCHAR2(9);
BEGIN
 --// Calculate local time (SCR 18938)//
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,SYSDATE,v_local_date);
 END IF;

 temp_buffer :=:control_block.contract_id;
 :control_block.chapter_id :=:global.chapter_id;
 SELECT
 company
 INTO :company_name
 FROM
 contracts
 WHERE contract_id = temp_buffer
 AND contract_type = 'RG'
 AND chapter_id =:global.chapter_id
 AND v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE + 10); /* ModIFied by HCL CONSULTING */
 --SYSDATE between eff_date AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+1); --- SCR 18938
 NEXT_ITEM;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT
 contract_id,
 company
 INTO
 :control_block.contract_id,
 :control_block.company_name
 FROM
 contracts
 WHERE
 upper(company) LIKE ( '%'
 || temp_buffer
 || '%' )
 AND v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE + 10) --SYSDATE between eff_date AND nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+1) -- SCR 18938
 AND contract_type = 'RG'
 AND chapter_id =:global.chapter_id;
 /* ModIFied by HCL CONSULTING */

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 :control_block.contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :control_block.company_name := NULL;
 list_values;
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 show_error('5150');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 :control_block.contract_id := temp_buffer;
 :control_block.company_name := NULL;
 list_values;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_ELAPSED_TIME
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_elapsed_time(fa_from_date in varchar2,
 fa_to_date in varchar2,
 fa_result out varchar2)
 IS
begin
select
 (24*mod(fa_from_date - fa_to_date,1)) ||':'||
 (mod(mod(fa_from_date- fa_to_date,1)*24,1)*60 ) diff_hrs2
 into 
 fa_result
 from dual;
exception 
when others then 
 fa_result := null;

end;

declare
 lv_result varchar2(1000);
 CURSOR cur_code
 IS
 SELECT
 distinct
 sd.unit_id,
 sd.contract_id,
 sd.sample_type,
 sd.frozen_flag,
 --sh.chapter_id,
 sd.box_id,
 sd.coll_date,sd.chapter_id,
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(ut.chapter_id,rgt.tube_check_in_date) tube_check_in_date,
 trunc(24*(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(ut.chapter_id,sysdate)-lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(ut.chapter_id,rgt.tube_check_in_date))) ||':'||
 lpad(ceil(mod(24*60*(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(ut.chapter_id,sysdate)-lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(ut.chapter_id,rgt.tube_check_in_date)),60)),2,'0') diff_minute 
 
 -- lpad(ceil(mod(24*60*(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(rec_code.chapter_id,sysdate)-lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(rec_code.chapter_id,rec_code.tube_check_in_date)),60)),2,'0')
 FROM
 sample_shipment_hdr sh,
 sample_shipment_det sd,
 utrs ut,
 rgt_tubes rgt
 WHERE sh.box_id = sd.box_id
 and ut.unit_id = sd.unit_id
 and rgt.unit_id = ut.unit_id
 and ut.chapter_id = rgt.chapter_id
 AND ((TRUNC(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(ut.chapter_id,sd.insert_date)) between (:control_block.from_date) and (:control_block.to_date))
 OR :control_block.from_date is null and :control_block.to_date is null)
 AND (SD.UNIT_ID = :control_block.unit_id or :control_block.unit_id is null)
 AND (ut.test_id = :control_block.test_id or :control_block.test_id is null)
 AND (sd.contract_id = :CONTROL_BLOCK.contract_id or :control_block.contract_id is null) 
 AND (
 (sd.chapter_id = :control_block.facility_from or sh.facility_code= :control_block.facility_to)
 or :control_block.facility_from is null and :control_block.facility_to is null

 AND sd.chapter_id in 
 (
 select code

 where code_type = 'STFAC'
 and sort_sequence_1 ='0'
 and Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(ut.chapter_id,sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+10)
 
 ) 
 AND
 
 sh.facility_code in (
 select code
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'STFAC'
 and sort_sequence_1 ='0'
 and Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(ut.chapter_id,sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+10)
 
 ) 
 
 
 AND sd.unit_id not in 
 (
 SELECT
 int_unit_id
 FROM sample_shipment_in_det)
 order by 
 sd.chapter_id,sd.unit_id;
 
 
 
 
 
 lv_sucess Number :='0';
 lv_time number;
 lv_hrs number;
 
 
BEGIN


 IF (:control_block.contract_id is not null or :control_block.from_date is not null or :control_block.to_date is not null or :control_block.test_id is not null or
 :control_block.facility_from is not null or :control_block.facility_to is not null or :control_block.unit_id is not null or :control_block.s_unit_id is not null) then
 --go_block('CONTROL_BLOCK_TEST');
 -- clear_block;
 go_block('sample_shipment_det');
 clear_block;
 lv_sucess :=0;
 go_block('sample_shipment_det');
 first_record;
 
 FOR rec_code IN cur_code 
 LOOP
 lv_sucess :=1;
 :sample_shipment_det.unit_id := rec_code.unit_id;
 :sample_shipment_det.contract_id := rec_code.contract_id;
 :sample_shipment_det.sample_type := rec_code.sample_type;
 :sample_shipment_det.frozen_flag := rec_code.frozen_flag;
 :sample_shipment_det.box_id := rec_code.box_id;
 :sample_shipment_det.coll_date := rec_code.coll_date;
 :sample_shipment_det.SHIPPED_OUT_FACILITY := rec_code.chapter_id;
 :sample_shipment_det.checked_in_time := rec_code.tube_check_in_date;
 :sample_shipment_det.elapsed_time :=rec_code.diff_minute;
 :sample_shipment_det.chapter_id := rec_code.chapter_id;
 next_record;
 lv_sucess :=1;
 :system.message_level :=25;
 END LOOP;
 
 IF lv_sucess = 0 THEN 
 show_error('9188');
 go_block('CONTROL_BLOCK');
 END IF;
 IF :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD='TRUE' then 
 first_record;
 END IF; 
 
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN 
 show_error('9188');
 check_package_failure;
 
 
 END;
